tasks.short: Provide written media commentary on public policy and political events

steps.what: Read the actual media request and original policy documents, political statements and event records, verifying dates, quotations, source context and permitted use
inputs: Actual commentary request and original public-policy/event sources
outputs: Verified facts, quotations and actual commentary scope

steps.what: Assess the actual political issue and choose the commentary's argument, criticism, qualifications and distinction between observed fact and interpretation
inputs: Actual original sources and verified commentary scope
outputs: Actual chosen argument and source-linked claims with caveats

steps.what: Write the actual commentary using a bounded wording helper limited to the scientist's chosen argument and verified sources, rejecting unsupported political claims or quotations
inputs: S2 actual argument and s1 verified source passages
outputs: Actual commentary draft with traceable factual claims

loop.purpose: Express the scientist's actual commentary argument clearly
loop.input: Chosen argument, actual quotations and verified source passages
loop.output: Proposed commentary wording with source-linked factual claims
loop.check: Scientist checks political meaning, every quotation and factual claim, caveats and distinction between fact and opinion
loop.stop: Reject invented quotations, unsupported interpretation or changed argument and write manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Critical commentary wording varies; fixed source and length fields use the existing document template

steps.what: Check the complete actual commentary against original sources and the chosen argument, correct misleading implications and produce the exact final media version and intended outlet
inputs: Complete commentary and original source evidence
outputs: Exact checked final commentary with outlet and attribution details

steps.what: Save the exact final review version in the same existing internal document workspace
outputs: Stored exact final commentary for internal editorial review

steps.what: Review the actual complete final commentary in the existing internal workspace and decide whether that exact content, attribution and outlet submission are authorised
inputs: S5 exact final commentary and actual organisational media authority
outputs: Actual approval or rejection of the exact external media submission

steps.what: Submit only the exact authorised final commentary to the actual identified media outlet
inputs: Exact final commentary and valid s6 actual media-submission authority
outputs: Actual media submission and delivery result

tasks.design: Use {DOCS} for bounded wording drafts from the scientist's actual argument and verified sources in {OTHER}, the original policy and media source repositories. The complete final commentary is checked and then reviewed by the real internal editorial authority before the separate {EMAIL} submission to the outlet.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual commentary arguments require prose composition even after source and political analysis are complete.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded wording helper can express an explicit argument without supplying new political facts.
tasks.still_hard: Political interpretation, quotations and potentially misleading implications require original-source judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Take responsibility for a defensible argument and acknowledge uncertainty.

ambition.what: Reduce bounded wording effort in actual written media commentary.

reach.task: Review actual final organisational media commentary

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: bounded drafting can suggest wording from an explicit argument and supplied source passages; political analysis and final factual/editorial checks remain human work.

assumptions: Representative commissioned written commentary through an actual organisational media route, not live broadcast commentary or a measured mix of all media work. Source publishers produce original records; s1 counts retrieval, quotation/date/context checks and scope preparation. S2 counts actual political analysis and argument choice. No free evidence pack or generated political position is assumed.

S3 accepts only actual source passage IDs, verified quotations and scientist-selected claims. The loop checks meaning, not just citation existence. Try existing document templates and reference fields first; current runtime earns no new benefit. No new source browsing or unsourced current fact is claimed by this model-knowledge design.

S4 is author checking, not approval. S5 is ordinary ungated same-system save, minimum integer share1 representing negligible time, fully retained and without saving. S6 must be the real existing independent internal media authority, not the author approving herself or a newly invented reviewer. If actual publication rights differ, map that route before submission.

The final version exists before s6. Any argument, quotation, content, attribution or outlet change voids a1 and requires s4-s6 again. S7 is its own actual retained send; the outlet's later editing/publication is actual outlet work and not a focal-role saving or hidden automated publication.
Baseline95 focal/5 other-role points; shares are illustrative task effort independent of prompt priors. This workflow does not extrapolate prose savings to live oral commentary.
unknowns: How much actual prose wording remains after argument and source work?
Who holds real internal media-submission authority?
Which cases are written commentary rather than live appearances?
research_questions: Observe an actual written commentary and distinguish source checks, political argument, prose drafting, complete checking, real editorial authority and external submission.

already_counted.description: Actual source and political analysis, retained prose production/checking, complete final author check, ordinary save and actual submission total83 focal points out of95.
Actual independent editorial-authority review retains5 points, equivalent to5/95 of focal baseline.

incremental.description: Maintain source-bound drafting examples and inspect argument drift beyond retained per-commentary checks.

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete final commentary stored in s5 including all claims, quotations, caveats, attribution and intended outlet; changes require renewed s6 authority

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High:30*.40=12 prose points/95*100-3=9.631, rounded down9.6. Low: politically sensitive wording needs25 of30 prose points for actual manual rewriting and source-context checks rather than18, leaving5 saved;5/95*100-3=2.263, rounded down2.2. Source25, argument25, complete check13, save1, actual authority5 and submission1 remain. An argument-preservation and source-context case, unmeasured.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Draft legislative proposals, speeches, correspondence and government policy papers

steps.what: Read the actual governmental drafting request, existing policy decisions and original legislative or policy sources, verifying jurisdiction, dates, source versions and required document form
inputs: Actual drafting request, existing policy mandate and original legislative/policy material
outputs: Verified actual drafting scope and source references

steps.what: Analyse the actual policy question and choose proposed provisions, argument or message, exclusions and caveats and explicitly map the selected content to the required government document structure
inputs: Actual verified mandate, original sources and required government form
outputs: Actual selected substantive content and explicit structure/source mapping

steps.what: Populate the actual draft's explicit headings, selected provision or topic identifiers and checked reference fields from the scientist's chosen mapping
inputs: S2 actual selected structure/content mapping and s1 verified reference values
outputs: Actual document shell with selected fields and missing-source exceptions

steps.what: Write the actual legislative, speech, correspondence or policy narrative using a bounded wording helper limited to selected substantive content and verified sources
inputs: Actual selected provisions/argument and verified sources within populated structure
outputs: Actual governmental working draft with traceable provisions and claims

loop.purpose: Express actual chosen governmental draft content
loop.input: Selected provisions or argument, actual document form and verified source passages
loop.output: Proposed wording mapped to chosen content and supplied sources
loop.check: Scientist checks substantive meaning, jurisdiction/context, quotations, cross-references and every claim against originals and selected policy choices
loop.stop: Reject changed policy meaning, unsupported claims or invented legal references and complete manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Substantive explanatory wording varies while explicit structure and reference fields are deterministic in s3

steps.what: Check the complete actual working draft against the real mandate, original sources and chosen content, correcting internal contradictions, missing caveats and inaccurate references
inputs: Complete actual working draft and original mandate/source material
outputs: Checked complete actual governmental working draft

steps.what: Save the complete working draft in the same existing document workspace
inputs: Checked complete actual governmental working draft
outputs: Stored actual draft for its real subsequent governmental process

tasks.design: Use {DOCS} to populate the actual government document's selected structure and checked references and draft wording around the scientist's explicit substantive choices. The scientist reads original {OTHER} legislative/policy repositories, chooses content and checks the complete working draft.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual selected content can require repeated structure/reference entry and prose composition.
tasks.enabler_now: Explicit field population is deterministic and a bounded wording helper can use the actual selected policy content.
tasks.still_hard: Policy intent and jurisdiction-specific meaning require substantive original-source checks.
tasks.human_edge: Choose defensible provisions or arguments and recognise unintended implications.

ambition.what: Reduce demonstrated repeated governmental drafting composition.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: explicit government-document fields can be populated deterministically and bounded drafting can express supplied content; actual policy choices and source checks remain human work.

assumptions: Representative actual working-document drafting episode, not a measured mixture of all legislative proposals, speeches, correspondence and policy papers. Actual request owners provide the mandate and source authors the originals; s1 counts retrieval and jurisdiction/version checks and s2 substantive analysis, content choices and explicit mapping. No free curated policy pack is assumed.

S3 uses actual document form, section/topic or provision ID, selected content mapping and verified source/version reference. Missing fields remain manual. Try native document templates and reference tools first; existing use yields zero new runtime benefit. No named governmental system or unverified legal claim is invented.

S4 may express chosen content but cannot select policy, invent provisions or alter legal meaning. Retained checking covers meaning and sources, with complete author checking in s5. It is not an author approving herself.

The statement calls for drafts and prepared government-use materials; this episode ends with the actual complete working draft. Formal legislative introduction, government adoption, speech delivery, signed correspondence or external distribution requires the real independent final-version authority and its own gated action, counted if the actual episode includes it. None is hidden in the ordinary save.

Same-system save share1 is negligible, fully retained and ungated with no saving. Shares are illustrative task effort independent of prompt priors; unknown document-type frequency is not extrapolated.
unknowns: Which actual structure and reference fields are manual?
Which document forms and wording constraints apply to the real request?
What actual subsequent governmental approval and release route applies?
research_questions: Observe one actual government draft and separate source preparation, substantive policy choices, fixed fields, prose composition and complete checking.

already_counted.description: Actual mandate/source verification, substantive content selection, retained narrative production/checking, complete draft check and ordinary save remain in s1, s2 and s4-s6.

incremental.description: Maintain actual document-form mappings and source-bound wording examples beyond retained per-draft substantive checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High:15 actual fixed-field points+25*.40=10 prose points=25 gross less4 upkeep=21. Low: incompatible government house forms leave10 of15 fixed-field points manual, and sensitive provision wording requires18 of25 narrative points rather than15;5 fields+7 prose points save, less4 upkeep=8. All25 source work,20 substantive content choices,14 complete check and1 save remain. An actual document-form and policy-wording compatibility case, unmeasured.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: Actual editorial authorities retain external organisational commentary release
Actual governmental authorities retain policy adoption and formal document release
skills_to_grow: Verify original political and policy sources
Separate substantive content choices from wording
Map actual government document fields explicitly
Check political and policy meaning beyond reference existence
Distinguish author checks and ordinary saves from external submission authority
role.ambitious_version: A political scientist who reduces bounded composition effort while retaining source judgement, substantive political analysis and responsibility for actual claims.
